content.source: ESC guideline page (antithrombotic therapy with OAC and antiplatelet agents)

recommendations.recommendation: In patients with an indication for OAC with VKA in combination with aspirin and/or clopidogrel, careful regulation of the dose intensity of VKA with a target INR of 2.0–2.5 and a time in the therapeutic range >70% should be considered.
recommendations.notes: Aimed at reducing bleeding risk when combining VKA with antiplatelet agents.

recommendations.recommendation: When rivaroxaban is used and concerns about high bleeding risk (HBR) prevail over ischaemic stroke, rivaroxaban 15 mg o.d. should be considered in preference to rivaroxaban 20 mg o.d. for the duration of concomitant SAPT or DAPT.
recommendations.notes: Dose reduction advised while on concomitant single or dual antiplatelet therapy.

recommendations.recommendation: In patients at high bleeding risk (HBR), dabigatran 110 mg b.i.d. should be considered in preference to dabigatran 150 mg b.i.d. for the duration of concomitant SAPT or DAPT, to mitigate bleeding risk.
recommendations.notes: Dose selection to balance ischaemic vs bleeding risks during concomitant antiplatelet therapy.

recommendations.recommendation: In patients requiring anticoagulation and treated medically, a single antiplatelet agent in addition to an OAC should be considered for up to 1 year.
recommendations.notes: Combination therapy for medically managed patients.

recommendations.recommendation: In patients treated with an OAC, aspirin plus clopidogrel for longer than 1 week and up to 1 month should be considered in those with high ischaemic risk or with other anatomical/procedural characteristics that are judged to outweigh the bleeding risk.
recommendations.notes: Short term triple therapy window (aspirin + clopidogrel + OAC) for selected high ischaemic risk patients.

recommendations.recommendation: In patients requiring OAC, withdrawing antiplatelet therapy at 6 months while continuing OAC may be considered.
recommendations.notes: De-escalation strategy to reduce bleeding risk after initial period.

recommendations.recommendation: The use of ticagrelor or prasugrel as part of triple antithrombotic therapy is not recommended.
recommendations.notes: Prohibition against more potent P2Y12 inhibitors in triple therapy due to bleeding risk.

abbreviations_and_notes.CHA2DS2-VASc: Congestive heart failure, Hypertension, Age ≥75 years, Diabetes mellitus, Stroke or transient ischaemic attack, Vascular disease
